skills.name: PDB Discovery And Download
skills.description: Find a relevant PDB entry from natural language and download structure file.
skills.when_to_use: User asks to find/select structures from keywords or topic first.
workflow: Use search_pdb(query) to find candidate IDs.
Use fetch_pdb_info(pdb_id) for top candidate validation.
Use download_pdb_file(pdb_id, format='cif') to persist chosen structure.
skills.stop_when: Chosen structure is downloaded and path is reported.

skills.name: Structure Precheck
skills.description: Inspect entry metadata and split complex/chains for downstream analysis readiness.
skills.when_to_use: User asks to inspect composition, chains, or preprocessing steps.
workflow: Use fetch_pdb_info(pdb_id) for metadata.
Use split_complex or split_pdb_by_chain on downloaded/local structure.
Summarize resulting files and recommended analysis entry points.
skills.stop_when: Structure components are split and summarized.

skills.name: Protein Nucleic Acid Binding Pair Annotation
skills.when_to_use: User asks for binding pair annotation or contact residues on a specific structure.
workflow: Use download_pdb_file for provided PDB ID when needed.
Use annotate_binding_pairs with pdb_path and cutoff.
Return key pair statistics and file paths.
Use read_result_file to summarize key binding pairs and their distances for user interpretation.
skills.stop_when: Binding pair annotation result is generated.

skills.name: Chain Fragment Extraction
skills.description: Extract specific chain/region for focused analysis.
skills.when_to_use: User asks to isolate chain fragments or residue ranges.
workflow: Download structure if only PDB ID is provided.
Use extract_fragment(pdb_path, chain, start, end).
Return fragment file path and suggested next analysis.

skills.name: Contact Map Analysis
skills.description: Compute structural contact map for chain or full structure.
skills.when_to_use: User asks for contact maps, residue contact topology, or graph-ready structure maps.
workflow: Download structure if needed.
Use calculate_contact_map with mode and optional chain.
Explain output JSON and key interpretation.
skills.stop_when: Contact map file is generated and interpreted.

skills.name: Binding Site Prediction
skills.description: Predict DNA/RNA binding sites for protein structure.
skills.when_to_use: User asks for binding site prediction rather than deterministic contact annotation.
workflow: Use predict_binding_sites(pdb_id_or_path, ligand_type).
Summarize output CSV and confidence interpretation.
Report output files for download.
skills.stop_when: Prediction outputs are produced and summarized.

skills.name: Feature Extraction Pipeline
skills.description: Extract language-model and empirical features for downstream modeling.
skills.when_to_use: User asks for feature extraction, model-ready descriptors, or comparative feature sets.
workflow: Download structure when needed.
Use extract_language_model_features and/or extract_empirical_features.
Summarize feature files and expected downstream usage.
Use read_result_file to interpret key features and their implications for modeling. Do not read numpy files directly, only summary CSV or text outputs.

skills.name: Sequence Interaction Prediction
skills.description: Predict interaction from protein and nucleic sequences.
skills.when_to_use: User provides sequences without structure and asks interaction likelihood/classification.
workflow: Use predict_interaction(protein_sequence, nucleic_sequence).
Summarize prediction output and caveats.
Do not run structure tools unless explicitly requested.
